d: For years, Harry Kane was the punchline of football’s trophy jokes, with his individual brilliance at Tottenham often overshadowed by the lack of major silverware. His move to Bayern Munich changed that narrative, and a prolific 2025-26 season with club and country has now taken him to the Ballon d’Or summit. Kane’s journey from being mocked for his trophy drought to becoming the first Englishman since Michael Owen in 2001 to win the award is a remarkable turnaround. Rupha Ramani breaks down Harry Kane’s rise, his Bayern Munich success and how he turned years of doubt into the biggest…
